entry_thesis: IREN is a dual-catalyst play: Bitcoin stabilizing at ~$66K after a brutal February selloff (-30%) combined with a massive AI infrastructure pivot (NVIDIA preferred partner, 150K GPU fleet targeting $3.7B annualized AI Cloud revenue). As BTC recovers and institutional ETF inflows resume after a 5-week outflow streak, mining stocks with strong AI optionality like IREN will lead the rebound. IREN is down ~25% from its February highs purely on crypto contagion, yet its AI/data center business continues to grow — creating a compelling entry point.
risk: BTC fails to hold mid-$60K support and retests February lows near $60K, dragging IREN lower despite strong AI fundamentals.
catalyst: Imminent GPU fleet expansion announcement (150K NVIDIA B300 GPUs) + Bitcoin ETF institutional re-entry signaled by IBIT $199M inflow breaking 5-week outflow streak
